claims.evidence: Witness report shows two lenses are present, but exact lens model names/specs (18-55mm vs 50mm) are not readable in the photo.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: No close-up of lens glass/condition and no test shots or video playback evidence in the witness report.
Witness report identifies the item as a Nikon DSLR camera body.

risks.risk: Exact camera model is unknown; pricing varies a lot by Nikon DSLR model (e.g., entry vs midrange) and features.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body model name/number (e.g., on the front/top) and the rear LCD showing model info.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown Nikon DSLR body with no confirmed model-specific value.

risks.risk: Lens specifications may not actually be 18-55mm and 50mm (or may be different versions), affecting value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lens name rings/labels showing focal length and model (and mount compatibility).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/uncertain kit lenses with no confirmed focal lengths.

risks.risk: Condition of lens glass is unknown (possible haze, fungus, scratches) which directly affects usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Macro/close-up shots of both front and rear lens elements under light, plus a photo of the lens glass at an angle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case with possible lens haze/scratches (as not guaranteed to be optically clean).

risks.risk: Camera functionality is unverified (autofocus, buttons/dials, shutter, and any faults).
risks.proof: A short video showing autofocus working and recording, plus a still photo test and a menu screen showing shutter count/usage if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially non-fully functional until tested.

risks.risk: Sensor condition is unknown (dust, scratches, dead pixels) and cannot be assessed from the current report.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank wall/sky at high f-stop (e.g., f/16) and a close-up photo of the sensor area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case sensor needs cleaning or has visible issues.

risks.risk: Included accessories are incomplete/uncertain (battery, charger, memory card, caps/hoods). Missing items reduce value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included: battery model, charger, memory card, straps, lens caps/hoods, cables, and any manuals/box.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/uncertain accessories (only what is clearly shown).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Nikon DSLR model number/name on the body (front/top/rear).
Close-up photos of both lenses’ label rings showing focal length and lens model (18-55mm and 50mm confirmation).
Macro close-ups of both lenses’ front and rear glass elements (under light) to confirm no haze/fungus/scratches.
Short video test showing autofocus and recording quality, plus a still photo test.
Photo/video evidence of sensor condition (test shot against a plain background) and any available shutter count/usage screen.
A complete accessories lay-out photo showing battery, charger, memory card, straps, and all caps/hoods included.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR body with two lenses present, but the exact camera model, lens models, optical condition, and functionality are not verifiable from the report. Without those, any pricing would be too uncertain for a safe purchase in Abuja.
